title: Speaking: Listen and Repeat II
focus: Reproduzir frases longas com agrupamento prosódico

content.text: (grupos de pensamento), com pausas naturais e palavras funcionais (
Ao final da aula você consegue:
guardar e repetir uma frase longa porque a memoriza em 2–3 blocos, não em 15 palavras soltas.
repetir oito frases com pausas e palavras funcionais adequadas.

content.text: Técnica: ouvir em blocos, repetir em blocos
do original (a voz desce no fim).
🎧 > “Visitors who would like a guided tour | should meet in front of the main entrance | at ten o'clock.”
visitors – guided tour | meet – main entrance | ten o'clock
O aluno repete 3 vezes: 1) só os ganchos; 2) bloco por bloco; 3) frase inteira.
4.1 Divida em blocos (aluno marca | e depois lê)
The museum will be closed on Monday because of a private event.
Students who want to join the choir should sign up at the music department.
If you lose your key, you will have to pay a fee to replace it.
Most of the books on the third floor can be borrowed for two weeks.
4.2 Troque e fale (mantendo o ritmo dos blocos)
→ Visitors with a ticket / can enter the gallery / until six → Employees with a badge / can park in Lot B / at no cost → Members of the club / can borrow equipment / on weekends

at ten o'clock. → in front of the main entrance at ten o'clock. → should meet in front of the main entrance at ten o'clock. → Visitors who would like a guided tour should meet in front of the main entrance at ten o'clock.

questions.questionText: In natural speech, “to” in “going to the library” is usually weak: /tə/.

content.text: Contexto: visita a um museu de ciências.
; o aluno repete. Pontuação: 2 = perfeita · 1 = sentido completo com pequenos erros · 0 = perdeu conteúdo.
Welcome to the City Science Museum, which first opened in 1952.
The space exhibit on the second floor is our most popular attraction.
Visitors are asked not to use flash photography inside the galleries.
If you have a large bag, please leave it at the coat check near the entrance.
Children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult at all times.
The planetarium show begins every hour and lasts about thirty minutes.
You can buy books and souvenirs at the gift shop before you leave.
Thank you for visiting, and we hope you'll come back for our new exhibit next spring.
frases com nota 0 ou 1 → aumente a frase por blocos e repita.

Escolha um audioguia de museu no YouTube (2 min). Fale junto 5 vezes.
Pause o audioguia depois de cada frase e repita sem olhar. Anote quantas acertou.
